news.title: ‘Prank’ involving eggs, pellet guns lands 4 KSU students in jail
news.summary: Four Kennesaw State University students are facing felony charges after police say a prank involving eggs and pellet guns escalated into an alleged assault at an off-campus apartment complex.

news.title: Accused racer arrested after crash killed Gwinnett couple
news.summary: A Gwinnett County man died on his 62nd birthday along with his wife in May, and police say the street racer who caused the crash and ran was arrested Wednesday.

news.title: Student brings weapon to metro Atlanta high school, principal says
news.summary: A weapon was detected at a metro Atlanta high school on Friday morning after a student brought it onto campus, according to the school’s principal.

news.title: Crash involving Marietta police SUV leaves multiple people injured
news.summary: A crash involving a Marietta police vehicle is under investigation.

news.title: Survivor of Gwinnett plane crash was ‘inches from death,’ pastor says
news.summary: A 72-year-old Florida man who flew for the Air Force and Pan Am is recovering after a plane crash near Lawrenceville killed a Roswell tech founder.

news.title: Masked suspects sought in Atlanta food market robbery
news.summary: Atlanta police are seeking several individuals in a robbery and aggravated assault at a food market on Alison Court.
